summary: Master CBDC design, ISO 20022, and payment system modernization. Lead central bank digital operations with expert-led training. Enroll today.
lede: Central bank digital operations training helps policy, payment and stability professionals assess digital finance's impact on core functions. Practical exercises build capability in modernizing payment infrastructure, designing CBDC distribution models, and evaluating stablecoin and cyber risks. Learners also map payment data to ISO 20022, examine digital currencies' effects on monetary policy, and develop oversight and interoperability plans that account for legacy-system constraints.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals tasked with maintaining the integrity and efficiency of the national financial system during the digital transition.
audience: Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) Project Managers
Digital Identity and KYC Framework Architects
modules: Digital Economy Foundations for Central Banks
Modernizing Payment Systems and RTGS Infrastructure
Central Bank Digital Currency Design and Architecture
Monetary Policy Transmission in Digital Economies
Digital Asset Regulation and Stablecoin Oversight
SupTech and AI in Central Bank Operations
Cyber Resilience for Digital Financial Infrastructures
Financial Inclusion and Digital Identity Frameworks
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of central bank functions, including monetary policy and payment system oversight. Familiarity with basic financial technology concepts and the role of commercial banks in the economy is recommended. No prior programming or DLT technical experience is required, as the focus is on strategic and operational integration.
